unit.title: Introduction to Electrical Energy and DC Circuits

title: KVL/KCL practice and network-reduction techniques
summary: Three-mesh KVL and source-power calculation; two-node KCL analysis; series/parallel reduction rules for R, L and C; and two equivalent-resistance practice networks.
transcription_policy: Notebook order and meaning are preserved; grammar and awkward English are lightly cleaned. Worked equations and numerical results are kept source-faithful. Where a handwritten intermediate sign conflicts with the equation immediately before and after it, the discrepancy is called out explicitly rather than silently changed. Incomplete network-reduction working is left incomplete rather than guessed.

mapped_topics.label: Circuit elements: resistance, inductance and capacitance
